content.metaTitle: Kanishk Chhabra - React.js Software Engineer | Delhi
content.metaDescription: Kanishk Chhabra is a Delhi-based React.js software engineer with 3+ years of experience shipping high-performance TypeScript applications and scalable frontend systems.
content.openGraphDescription: Portfolio showcasing React, TypeScript, performance optimization, and enterprise-grade product delivery experience.
heroNotes: I build high-performance React and TypeScript applications that feel fast, intentional, and reliable.
My work spans enterprise wealth platforms, analytics products, and modern frontend systems where performance and maintainability matter.
content.aboutHeading: Three years of shipping high-impact frontend products.
aboutParagraphs: I’m a React.js engineer who cares deeply about the quality of what ships. I focus on clean component architecture, strong performance budgets, modern state management, and interfaces that feel intentional and reliable. Over the last three years, I’ve built production systems in wealth management, fintech, and analytics products using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and REST APIs.

I enjoy the balance between engineering discipline and product thinking. Whether I’m refactoring large codebases, integrating backend services, or building new features from scratch, I aim to bring the same level of care to scalability, maintainability, and long-term product impact.
content.experienceHeading: Built in production. Not just side projects.
content.projectsHeading: Products I’ve helped build and scale.
content.projectsIntro: Wealth management, retail investing, analytics, and commerce—built for real users, real stakes, and measurable outcomes.
content.contactIntro: I'm open to the right opportunity. That could be a product-focused software engineering role, a team working on something genuinely interesting, or a freelance project worth putting real effort into. Drop a line and let's talk.

bullets: Owned end-to-end delivery of complex React + TypeScript modules across five enterprise wealth management products.
Cut UI development time by 80% by building and maintaining shared component systems used across multiple applications.
Raised performance of a 200K+ LOC React codebase through rendering improvements, better state handling, and focused refactoring.
Partnered with backend teams to design and integrate REST APIs with secure authentication flows.
Introduced reusable modules in a Turborepo monorepo that improved code sharing and long-term maintainability.
Shipped React dashboards and workflow automation features for portfolio monitoring used by advisors daily.
Drove a 30% gain in application responsiveness by optimizing data fetching and state management.
Created advisor dashboards, onboarding flows, and UI components that were adopted across the product.
Delivered features on schedule through close collaboration with product and backend teams.
Built a strong base in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, DBMS, SQL, Java, Hibernate, and Spring basics.
Solved 100+ DSA problems, strengthening algorithms and problem-solving skills.
